text:
I am a Computer Science student at The College of Idaho with experience in software development, machine learning, data analysis, and astrophysics research. My work combines programming with scientific research and technical communication.
Currently, I work as a research intern analyzing astronomical data and developing software tools that improve observational workflows. My interests include software engineering, machine learning, scientific computing, and game development.







Capture and analyze B-type star spectra
Develop observational automation tools and scripts
Write technical reports communicating research findings
Work with Python and data analysis techniques






Programming Languages
Python • C++ • SQL • LaTeX
Areas of Interest
Machine Learning • Data Analysis • Scientific Computing • Software Development • Data Visualization • Technical Writing






A strategy game developed in Godot featuring a modular card system and hex-based gameplay. Card data is loaded from external files, allowing mechanics and content to scale easily.
Current implemented systems include:

Card drawing
Movement on a hex grid
Card combat and health systems
Modular card definitions from data files
Currency rewards from defeated cards




Developed scripts and workflows supporting observatory operations and photometric data collection.
